usage: deskops runtime supervise [-h] [--root ROOT] [--herdr HERDR]
                                 [--max-iterations MAX_ITERATIONS]
                                 [--read-lines READ_LINES]
                                 [--timeout-ms TIMEOUT_MS]
                                 agent

positional arguments:
  agent                 Herdr agent name or pane id to supervise, e.g.
                        deskops-executor.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           DeskOps repository root.
  --herdr HERDR         Herdr executable.
  --max-iterations MAX_ITERATIONS
                        Stop after this many settle events instead of running
                        forever (mainly for testing).
  --read-lines READ_LINES
                        Terminal lines to capture from the agent on a blocked
                        or done settle.
  --timeout-ms TIMEOUT_MS
                        Give up waiting after this many milliseconds per
                        settle attempt (default: wait indefinitely).
